paper_packets.$comment: Each packet is consumed under the progressive-reading Formal Schema. Runtime additionally verifies the cross-object facts that JSON Schema cannot safely express: SHA-256 content hashes, unique section identities, globally unique anchor_id values, anchor candidate identity, and anchor-to-section/source relationships.

evidence_schema.$comment: target_id values must be unique. This property-level uniqueness relation is enforced deterministically at runtime because standard JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness by one property across array objects.
